Parameters:
----------------
	- ShadesActive
		(used to determine if this prop is currently visible)
	- wereberyloaded
		(used to determine if another avatar is currently active: 0 is off, 1 is on)
	- GlassesLensSize 
		(used to determine the radius or size of the glasses lenses: ranges from 0 to positive infinity)
	- GlassesArmLength
		(used to determine the length of the glasses arms: ranges from 0 to positive infinity)
	- GlassesArmRotation
		(used to determine the rotation of the glasses arms: ranges from 0 to positive infinity)
	- GlassesWidth
		(used to determine the width of the glasses: ranges from 0 to positive infinity)

Description:
----------------
Controls logic that triggers whenever my glasses are activated via chat command. You can adjust the dimensions of the glasses using the specified parameter values.

Also triggers different glasses based on the currently active model.

Description:
----------------
Controls logic that triggers and interacts with switching models, both PNGTuber and Vtuber.

The provided channel point redeem is meant to be used to swap between two different VTuber states and trigger the appropriate versions of props and effects. This logic also allows you to freely swap between an active PNGTuber and VTuber effortlessly when using my PNGTuber Nodegraph logic.
